args:
Fix Similar Outfits section to display flat-lay format images showing all outfit items instead of single product images. Currently in the OutfitDetail component's Similar Outfits section (components/outfit/SimilarOutfits.tsx), each similar outfit card shows only a single product image (e.g., just a dress). It should display a flat-lay style image showing ALL items in the outfit together, consistent with how the main outfit image appears at the top of the detail view. The discovery grid outfits don't have AI-generated flat-lay images, so implement a product thumbnail grid/collage fallback: 1) In SimilarOutfits.tsx, when an outfit doesn't have a flatLayImageUrl or flatLayImageBase64, create a visual grid showing thumbnails of all outfit.items (typically 3 items: dress, shoes, accessory) arranged in a collage layout instead of showing just outfit.imageUrl (which is a single product image). 2) The collage should show 2-4 product thumbnails in a
  clean grid layout (e.g., 2x2 or main item larger with smaller accessories). 3) Keep the existing flat-lay image display for outfits that DO have flatLayImageUrl. Check components/outfit/SimilarOutfits.tsx for the current implementation and components/outfit/OutfitCard.tsx for reference on how the main grid displays product thumbnail grids.
output:
Plan created at: `specs/chore-263f7396-similar-outfits-flat-lay-fallback.md`

**Summary:**
The fix is straightforward. The `SimilarOutfits.tsx` component already has:
1. A `ProductThumbnailGrid` component that renders a 2x2 collage of product thumbnails
2. A `useFlatLay` variable that correctly identifies whether an outfit has a flat-lay image

The problem is the render condition uses `displayImage` (which includes `imageUrl`) when it should use `useFlatLay`. The change is minimal:
- When `useFlatLay` is true → show the flat-lay image
- When `useFlatLay` is false → show `ProductThumbnailGrid` collage (regardless of `imageUrl`)
